name: The Shooting Star Addition
description: An unofficial addon for The Shooting Star. Halley calls a comet down onto your crosshair, leaving an icy crater with a glowing heart. Luna brings down the moon and leaves it buried in a crater, made of edible moon cheese with a molten heart. Proxima fires a solar flare and a coronal mass ejection, leaving a glassy bowl and scorched land. Stellar Convergence fires every selected weapon together. The skills join the Stellar Remote with power, damage and speed sliders. Works with The Shooting Star (Demo) 1.5.2 and RimuLib 1.2.2 on Fabric 1.20.1.
